bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
name=deploy-gaybbs-1
expected="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:restore-completed-f19f4f5)" || exit 74
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$name")" = "$expected" || { echo RESTORE_ACTIVE_IMAGE_MISMATCH;exit 74; }
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$name")" = true || exit 63
repo=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
work="$repo/.worktrees/restore-completed-features-20261115"
test "$(git -C "$work" rev-parse HEAD)" = f19f4f58f195db8ff0886bad18f35bdb163bd694 || exit 74
test -f "$work/artifacts/bot/src/bot/profileCompactHandlers.ts" || exit 81
test -f "$work/artifacts/bot/src/services/roomPublishedEditor.ts" || exit 82
grep -Fq 'pc:from:recruit' "$work/artifacts/bot/src/bot/recruitmentHandlers.ts" || exit 83
grep -Fq 'pc:from:room' "$work/artifacts/bot/src/bot/postingHandlers.ts" || exit 84
grep -Fq 'startCompactProfileEditor' "$work/artifacts/bot/src/gaybbsBot.ts" || exit 85
grep -Fq 'startSearchEditor' "$work/artifacts/bot/src/gaybbsBot.ts" || exit 86
grep -Fq 'likeTags' "$work/artifacts/bot/src/bot/recruitmentHandlers.ts" || exit 87
grep -Fq 'loveTags' "$work/artifacts/bot/src/bot/recruitmentHandlers.ts" || exit 88
docker exec "$name" node --check /app/gaybbs.mjs >/dev/null || exit 89
docker exec "$name" node -e 'const f=require("fs").readFileSync("/app/gaybbs.mjs","utf8"); for (const x of ["pc:from:recruit","pc:from:room","search:filter:","room:host:","クリエーター投稿"]) if(!f.includes(x)) process.exit(81);' || exit 90
echo RESTORE_IMAGE_ACTIVE=PASS
echo SEARCH_FILTER_HANDLER_BUNDLE=PASS
echo PROFILE_COMPACT_HANDLER_BUNDLE=PASS
echo ROOM_PROFILE_REGISTER_BUNDLE=PASS
echo RECRUIT_LIKE_LOVE_PROFILE_LINK=PASS
echo USERBOT="$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true)"
